worldcombat.skill.featherdance.summary: Toss a drifting mass of down over a foe to harshly lower its Attack; the cloud settles into a patch that covers anyone who walks through it. Dense packs a deeper cut in a smaller patch; Loose spreads wider but shallower.
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.use.1: Seal a doorway with a patch of down
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.use.2: Press a melee threat off an ally
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.descripti: A downy target loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and stays coated for %2$s.
The cloud spreads into a %1$s-block patch of down that lasts %2$s; %3$s feathers are thrown at once. Non-friendly bodies entering the patch are coated too (once each).
The down flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s-block hit radius over %3$s blocks (range %4$s); windup %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.dense.on: Dense: the same bundle packs tighter, a smaller patch but a deeper cut.
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.dense.off: Loose: the same bundle spreads wider, one stage shallower.
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.featherdance.preferenc: On packs the same bundle tighter: a smaller patch that cuts one more Attack stage; off spreads wider and shallower.
The companion only considers throwing while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw down under a Hold order.
